grade.summary: The submission gives a complete and correct proof. The lexicographically decreasing potential (product, number of entries greater than 1) establishes termination, and the process can never eliminate the last entry greater than 1. Primewise, the gcd of all p-adic valuations is invariant under the Euclidean transformation (a,b) to (min(a,b),|a-b|), which uniquely determines the terminal integer.
strengths: Correct well-founded potential proves termination for every sequence of choices.
Correctly establishes that a terminal board has exactly one entry greater than 1.
Identifies and proves the relevant primewise invariant.
Correctly reconstructs the unique final value from the initial valuations.
